content.description: Installing No. 2 shift fork and fork shaft with interlock pin

content.text: (f) Install No. 2 shift fork and fork shaft.

items: Apply MP grease to No. 2 interlock pin and install the pin into the shaft hole.

content.description: Placing No. 2 shift fork into the groove of No. 2 hub sleeve

items: Place No. 2 shift fork into the groove of No. 2 hub sleeve.
Install No. 2 fork shaft to the shift fork through the intermediate plate.

content.description: Installing the snap ring of No. 2 fork shaft

content.text: (g) Install the snap ring of No. 2 fork shaft.

content.description: Applying MP grease to No. 1 interlock pin and installing into intermediate plate

content.text: (h) Apply MP grease to No. 1 interlock pin and install the pin into the intermediate plate.

content.description: Installing No. 1 shift fork and fork shaft into hub sleeve and through intermediate plate

content.text: (i) Install No. 1 shift fork and fork shaft.

items: Install the groove of No. 1 shift fork into the groove of No. 1 hub sleeve.
Insert No. 1 fork shaft to the shift fork through the intermediate plate.
